text:
The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. The pizza sits in the top-right corner and is partly cut off by the frame. It looks like two rectangular slices of cheese pizza, each about 8 cm by 6 cm and roughly 1 cm thick.

Each slice has a volume of about 48 cm³. Pizza is fairly airy, so I used a density of about 0.6 g/cm³. That gives roughly 30 g per slice, or about 60 g for both. Allowing for some of the pizza being out of frame, I rounded up to about 70 g.
